scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sharnam/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @sharnam/api" "npm run dev -w @sharnam/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sharnam/shared && npm run build -w @sharnam/api && npm run build -w @sharnam/web
scripts.hostinger:build: npm run build -w @sharnam/shared && npm run build -w @sharnam/api && npm run build:hostinger -w @sharnam/web && node scripts/verify-hostinger-build.mjs && npx prisma generate
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
